checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-specs.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-specs stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Missed WARNING: the stable spec openspec/specs/date-selection/spec.md:232 (requirement "Date bar on every page state") still says "The notices (offline-ready, update, update-check-failed, storage warning) MUST stay visible above the bar and MUST NOT cover it." The change removes that note (REMOVED app-shell "Update check failure note" and main-page "Update check failed note"; MODIFIED main-page "Main page regions" no longer names it) but has no date-selection delta, and its proposal lists only settings, app-shell and main-page as modified capabilities. After archive the stable specs would contradict each other. The review's Freshness and Consistency sections ("None.") and its findings do not report this. It needs a finding: add a date-selection delta that modifies "Date bar on every page state" to drop "update-check-failed" from the notices list, and list date-selection under Modified Capabilities in proposal.md.
